text:
Priya Shah: Quick Q — running into parsing diffs between web + mobile SDKs.
Priya Shah: Server returning structured outputs for /v1/generate where the 'results' key sometimes comes back explicitly null vs omitted depending on model fallback. Mobile JSON decoder chokes when key missing.
Mike K: @Priya can you paste example? :thinking:
Priya Shah: ```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "request_id": "r-123",
  "model": "open-llm-v1",
  "results": null
}
```
Priya Shah: and sometimes we get:
Priya Shah: ```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8

{
  "request_id": "r-123",
  "model": "open-llm-v1"
}
```
Claire J: Hm. Our SDKs treat missing key == absent => map lookup returns nil on mobile? Older mobile JSON libs expect explicit null for optional arrays.
Alex R: We discussed sentinel behavior in schema earlier: decide either always include key (nullable) or omit (optional). Can't do both for same endpoint unless we version.
Mike K: Backcompat note: if we switch to always include "results": [] older clients that expect null might be fine. If some expect missing key that's the problem.
Priya Shah: Suggested rule: server should always emit the key for stable shape. If no entries => `results: []`. Null reserved for error state with an explicit error field.
schema-bot: lint: /specs/generate.json -> rule recommend: property 'results' required: false, nullable: false, default: []
Priya Shah: I'll open a tiny PR to enforce serializer to always emit results as array. pinging @eng-runtime for canary deploy.
Mike K: SGTM, please add one-line note for clients in release notes.
Claire J: Also add explicit Content-Type header enforcement in middleware — we've had clients that ignore charset.
Priya Shah: Will do. PR link when ready. Thanks! :thumbsup:
